anti_generic_signature_read: The combination of rounded split-stone basin, layered inner rind, contrasting angular and three-crowned mineral forms, and a completed exposed ridge now communicates the mineral-placement interpretation clearly. It is a stylized geological object, not a literal mineral specimen.
blind_action_read: The left panel shows two purple crystals at back-left and back-middle, two mint clusters at middle-left and center, and one purple crystal raised over back-right. The right panel seats that crystal in back-right to create three aligned exposed purple peaks. The other four pieces retain their locations and the camera framing remains consistent.
blind_form_read: The body now reads as a rounded brown pebble or split-stone basin: its continuous softened shoulder encloses a shallow interior, and several irregular inset terraces form visible bands at the rear and sides. It has substantial vertical thickness and a low open front rim. Nine circular growth seats retain three straight rows.
blind_held_read: A compact tabletop placement game, with an individual purple crystal suspended above the left-panel board. No hand is depicted.
blind_relationship_read: A single deposit fills the empty endpoint of a row. Separate circular seats accept one marker each; the row is established by aligned occupied sites without joining the crystals physically. All other sites remain vacant in the signature.
blind_subjects_read: Upright purple faceted crystals with flat blunt caps and mint three-lobed rounded mineral clusters, each on a broad circular foot. The mint forms are abstract, but their scalloped triple-crown silhouette is clear beside the angular crystals.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Fresh rereview sees a rounded pebble basin, continuous softened stone shoulder and several irregular inset terrace bands enclosing the field. This resolves the initial flat-octagonal-board reading.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: A volumetric split geode with rounded rock rind and low cavity, not a generic flat tray.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The signature shows nine circular seats in three straight rows. Vacant front and right sites reveal the grid; the inner geological bands do not bend its coordinates.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Nine shallow growth pockets in three straight rows, with exposed legible finite sites.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Purple six-sided towers have broad inward-tapered shoulders and visible flat tips. Mint clusters each show three rounded crowns on broad columns. All crowns stand clearly above the rind.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Tall blunt tooth crystals and three-lobed mineral bubbles rise above the low rim.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Planar faceted teeth contrast with scalloped three-column bubbles in silhouette as well as palette. There are no glyphs, mushroom caps, lore labels or color-encoded extra states. Tactile performance is not physically tested.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Two tactile crystal habits with meaningful state independent of color or lore; no X/O silhouettes or mushroom forms.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The left panel displays exactly those four seated pieces and one suspended purple tooth over the rear-right vacant site. The view looks down toward the rear row and exposes both back teeth.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Before: fixed elevated front view; teeth back-left/back-middle, bubbles middle-left/center, third tooth held above back-right.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The right panel seats the raised tooth at the endpoint of the same back row. Three separate exposed tooth peaks align; the two bubbles and two existing teeth keep their positions and the framing is unchanged.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: After: lower only the suspended tooth into back-right to complete three exposed peaks; retain all other active pieces and camera.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Broad feet individually occupy circular seats. The pair adds one endpoint deposit; no joined bridge, expanding crystal, capture, stack or automatic response appears. Permanence and exclusion are game rules, not a claimed retaining mechanism.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Placement deposits one permanent claim per pocket, excludes rival occupation, and forms an aligned vein without actual growth or mechanical joining.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The inventory view shows five angular markers and four rounded triplets on one basin. The signature has five active markers after placement, with four vacant sites and no extra printed hand, rod or support.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Complete inventory is one rind, five tooth markers and four bubble markers; signature omits unused supply rather than filling extra pockets.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Markers have broad disc feet, stout towers and rounded lobes, without secondary spurs or narrow necks. Repaired feet and well boundaries have clean continuous silhouettes. Underside flatness is supported by the documented print stance and digital gates, not established from these camera views.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Broad stable flat-bottomed forms, shallow open seats, blunt tips and clean interfaces; no fragile spectacle or thin-necked decorations.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Fresh images show evenly scaled markers and a low body below exposed crowns. Exact millimetres come separately from measure/geometry-audit.json, which reports the required normal and cluster envelopes; no image scale is claimed.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Normal envelope 140 by 130 by 32 mm and all clusters 28 mm wide by 26 mm tall.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Even straight spacing, open shallow wells and common round feet are visible. Exact spacing, depth, clearance and all eighteen zero-overlap fits are supplied by geometry-audit.json, not inferred from pixels.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: Pocket centers 36 mm apart, seat depth 2 mm and radial clearance 1 mm; every site accepts either habit.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Images clearly show one vertical deposition producing the third matching rear-row marker. Geometry-audit records only tooth_3 delta minus 55 mm. Revealed rules and rules-audit separately preserve empty setup, teeth/X first, alternating own vacant-site placement, no moving/stacking/capture/randomness/hidden information, immediate row-column-diagonal win, full-board draw, no score/tiebreaker and optional role exchange on reset; digital audit reports zero differences.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: The held tooth moves exactly 55 mm, and ordinary two-player tic-tac-toe preserves setup, turns, legal choices and terminal results with no new rules.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: No hardware, support scaffolding or extra component is depicted, and silhouettes contract upward. All twenty bound thickness and overhang reports pass for ten upright parts at the specified 0.4 mm nozzle/45-degree checks. These are digital printability checks only; no physical print, handling or human playtest has occurred.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: All ten parts print upright without supports or hardware; no render is claimed as physical fit, durability or complete human play evidence.

largest_risk: Physical printing, tactile recognition, practical fit, durability and human response remain untested. Digital print gates distinguish seven localized rind taper/spot samples from its independently measured structural 3 mm wall; no thin structural wall is reported.
